The local governments of Manila and Makati have advised the public to wear face masks as air quality reached “very unhealthy” levels.

The Manila city government said the poor air quality may still be linked to the Navotas landfill fire, which has continued to emit smoke since it broke out on April 10. | via Patrick Cruz/Rappler
